caption: Clock Tower, Trikala
composition: Stone clock tower on the fortress hill above the Litheos · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Litheos bank, a low stone bridge crosses the dark river and tile-roof houses climb toward the fortress. A tall rectangular stone clock tower with a balcony and clock faces stands on the hill. Cloud cover is about 7%, about 9.7°C. Street lamps line the bank. The tower is not floodlit.
